verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a SaaS billing platform that stores customer and payment data, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents retention settings, deletion of customer or billing data, or privacy-driven erasure. The customer portal, migration, and webhook items are about other capabilities and do not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
